---
title: "Forced Ueda System"
---

## System description

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& ay\\
\dot{y} &=& -x+by+\sin(z)\\
\dot{z} &=& 1
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=5,b=0.1$ and initial condition $(0,1,-3)$.

::: {.callout-note}

The simulation results for this system differ significantly from the
trajectories reported in the book by @sprott2023elegant for reasons that remain
unclear. Consequently, this system has not been visualized.

:::
